name_zh: 班达/马拉维/终身/独裁/转型/乔伊斯/女性/哈钦斯/终身
core_mode: M578 终身独裁/女性继任/民主转型/乔伊斯班达/女性总统
intellectual_tradition: 非洲女性政治/女性领导/民主转型/反独裁/议会民主/非洲妇女赋权/可持续和平/改革政治
description_zh: 乔伊斯·班达 (1956-) 马拉维第3任总统 (2012-2014)，马拉维首位女总统，领导了马拉维的民主转型和政治改革，她推翻了前总统贝斯特的独裁统治，建立了议会民主制度，恢复了人权和新闻自由。
description_en: Joyce Banda (1956-) Malawi's 3rd President (2012-2014), the first female president in Malawi, led Malawi's democratic transition and political reforms, overthrowing President Bingu wa Mutharika's dictatorship and establishing parliamentary democracy, restoring human rights and press freedom.
reason_zh: 班达总统领导的民主转型展示了女性领导如何推动制度变革，推翻独裁，建立民主，恢复人权和媒体自由。她的经验表明，女性领导可以成为反独裁和民主改革的重要推动者。
reason_en: President Banda's democratic transition demonstrates how female leadership can drive institutional change, overthrow dictatorship, establish democracy, restore human rights and media freedom. Her experience shows that female leaders can be key drivers of anti-dictatorship and democratic reform.

steps_en: Female rise: 2012-2014 first female president/female leadership/democratic awakening/women empowerment/African female politics
Anti-dictatorship movement: 2011-2013 overthrew election fraud/established new constitution/restored parliamentary democracy/anti-dictatorship
Democratic transition: 2013-2014 restored media freedom/human rights protection/multi-party establishment/electoral reform
Regional cooperation: 2012-2014 joined SADC/EAC/multilateral diplomacy/regional position enhancement/international status
expected_zh: 了解女性领导如何推动民主转型，学习班达总统在推翻独裁和建立民主制度方面的领导艺术，掌握性别平等和女性赋权在政治改革中的重要作用。
expected_en: Understand how female leadership drives democratic transformation, learn President Banda's leadership in overthrowing dictatorship and establishing democracy, master the role of gender equality and women's empowerment in political reform.
